You are polishing the remaining candidate components for production-grade UI. All files are in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/candidate/` except CandidateRow.tsx which is in `src/components/`.

Read each file fully, then apply these specific fixes:

### 1. StageTracker.tsx
- Change connector line `max-w-[48px]` to `max-w-[40px] min-w-[12px]` for better mobile behavior
- Ensure all stage dots have `transition-all duration-200` for smooth state changes
- Replace `text-[11px]` and `text-[10px]` with `text-xs` throughout
- Ensure dark mode colors have adequate contrast (any `/10` opacity should be `/20`)

### 2. ScorecardPanel.tsx
- Change Textarea from `min-h-[72px] resize-none` to `min-h-[80px] resize-y` to allow user expansion
- Standardize Card padding to `px-5 py-4`
- Replace `text-[11px]` and `text-[10px]` with `text-xs`
- Add `transition-colors` to all interactive buttons

### 3. ScorecardSummary.tsx
- Standardize padding to `px-5 py-4` on cards
- Replace `text-[11px]` and `text-[10px]` with `text-xs`
- Add `transition-all duration-300` to progress bar fills
- Ensure `bg-green-100` and `bg-emerald-100` are unified to `bg-emerald-100` (pick one)

### 4. InterviewsPanel.tsx
- Change card padding from `px-3 py-2.5` to `px-4 py-3` for better spacing
- Replace `text-[11px]` and `text-[10px]` with `text-xs`
- Add `overflow-y-auto scrollbar-thin` to any scrollable containers (if scrollbar-thin doesn't exist, just keep overflow-y-auto)
- Add `transition-colors` to status badges

### 5. AssigneeSelector.tsx
- Replace `text-[11px]` and `text-[10px]` with `text-xs`
- Add `transition-colors` to the Select component trigger
- Standardize padding

### 6. CandidateRow.tsx (in src/components/)
- Replace ALL `text-[10px]` with `text-xs` for accessibility (10px is too small)
- Replace `text-[11px]` with `text-xs` 
- Add `transition-colors` to all action buttons that don't have it
- Ensure tag chips have consistent `px-2 py-0.5 text-xs` sizing

### 7. AddToPoolButton.tsx
- Replace any inline conditional className string concatenation with `cn()` utility if available
- Replace `text-[11px]` with `text-xs`

### 8. ContactStrip.tsx
- Change padding from `px-4 py-3` to `px-5 py-4` to match other panels
- Replace `text-[11px]` with `text-xs`
- Change `max-w-[200px]` on email to `max-w-[240px]` for more room

### 9. CandidateTagInput.tsx
- Add `right-0` fallback to absolute-positioned dropdown to prevent left-edge overflow
- Replace `text-[10px]` and `text-[11px]` with `text-xs`
- Standardize tag chip padding to `px-2 py-0.5`

Do NOT change any component imports, props, or functionality. Only CSS/layout changes.
